# Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago

> The Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago is the nation's monetary authority, providing economic data, financial stability oversight, and public financial education since 1964.

The site serves as the official source for macroeconomic indicators, exchange rates, and financial soundness data. It also emphasizes community outreach through the National Financial Literacy Programme, educational initiatives, and cultural engagement through its arts collection.

## Key Topics

- Monetary Policy
- Financial Stability
- Economic Statistics
- Exchange Rates
- National Financial Literacy Programme
- AML/CFT Compliance
- Polymer Currency
- Central Bank Governance
- Financial Education
- Community Engagement
- Know Your Money
- Global Money Week
- Inflation Rates
- Payment Systems
- Central Bank Arts

## About the Central Bank

- [Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago](https://www.central-bank.org.tt): Homepage for Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago with monetary policy, financial stability, and education initiatives
- [About Us](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/about-us): Central Bank mission, vision, values, and organizational overview established 1964
- [Our History](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/about-us/our-history): Institutional history, milestones, and evolution since 1964 establishment
- [Governance at the Bank](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/about-us/governance-at-the-bank): Board structure, governance framework, and institutional management oversight
- [Our Leadership](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/about-us/governance-at-the-bank/our-leadership): Executive team, leadership roles, and senior management personnel

## Economic Data & Statistics

- [Data Centre](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/data-centre): Economic statistics, exchange rates, macroeconomic indicators, and financial soundness data
- [Data Centre - Glossary of Terms](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/data-center-glossary-of-terms): Glossary defining economic terms per BPM6 and IMF standards for central bank data

## Financial Regulation & Legal Framework

- [Legal Framework](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/about-us/legal-framework): Legislation, exchange control, insurance, fintech regulation, and e-money issuer framework
- [Anti-Money Laundering, Combating the Financing of Terrorism & Counter Proliferation Financing](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/core-functions/financial-stability/anti-money-laundering-combating-the-financing-of-terrorism-counter-proliferation-financing): AML/CFT/CPF supervisory guidance and compliance requirements for financial institutions

## Public Education & Financial Literacy

- [Public Education](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/public-education): National Financial Literacy Programme, Know Your Money resources, and financial awareness
- [Financial Education Us](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/nflp): National Financial Literacy Programme details, money management, and educational resources

## Outreach & Community Engagement

- [Outreach](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/outreach): Community engagement, public seminars, webinars, and Eric Williams Memorial Lecture Series
- [Corporate Social Responsibility](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/outreach/corporate-social-responsibility): CSR initiatives, charitable partnerships, arts, health, and community development programs

## Currency & Banknotes

- [Current Banknotes](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/bank-notes-and-coins/current-bank-notes): Polymer banknote series, security features, and currency identification guide

## Careers & Recruitment

- [Careers](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/careers): Career opportunities, internships, benefits, and recruitment information
- [Current Job Opportunities](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/about-us/careers/current-job-opportunities): Current job openings, application details, and employment opportunities
- [Internships](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/about-us/careers/internships): Vacation Internship Programme for university students and career development
- [Scholarships](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/about-us/careers/scholarships): De La Rue Currency Scholarship at UWI for economics, mathematics, data science

## Optional

- [Discover Central Bank Arts](https://www.central-bank.org.tt/discover-central-bank-arts): Central Bank Arts gallery, museum collection, and cultural heritage exhibitions
